status.description: Main state of the device (on/off, locked/unlocked, cleaning, etc.)

value.description: Numerical value representing bright status, temp level or sound volume

room.description: The target physical area / room where the device resides

color.description: Optional hex color value for smart lights

mode.description: Optional sub-mode for climate e.g., cool/heat

track.description: Optional music track name currently playing

artist.description: Optional music artist name currently playing

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Log of smart home activities or assistant alerts

id.description: Unique identifier of the log entry

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatting of UTC creation date

devices/{deviceId}.description: Secure storage collection of showroom or household IoT devices

logs/{logId}.description: Chronological system transaction logs for telemetry and diagnostics
